ai.title: AI Hydration Coach
ai.smartNotificationsDesc: Offline heuristics ranked by urgency, powered by your logs.

notif.urgentGapBodyQuiet: Bedtime quiet hours start soon. You're still {{remaining}} away from goal. Take one steady glass now to avoid late-night thirst.
notif.urgentGapBody: It's been {{duration}} since your last {{lastAmount}} and you're {{percent}}% behind the pace for this hour.
notif.urgentGapBodyNoLog: No drinks logged yet today. Starting with a full glass now will set the tone for the rest of the day.
notif.urgentGapRec2Sleep: Wrap hydration at least 1.5h before bed to protect your sleep.
notif.urgentGapRec2: Stack a second glass in ~45 min if you can.
notif.strategyBody: You still need {{remaining}} with {{timeLeft}} before quiet hours. Sip roughly {{perHour}} each hour to land comfortably.
notif.strategyRec1: Pair the next reminder with an existing habit (meetings, meals, or commute).
notif.strategyRec2: Prep a full bottle now so it is within reach during your focus blocks.
notif.trendDropBody: 7-day intake averaged {{avg7}} vs {{avgPrev}} previously. Goal days: {{hitRate}}%.
notif.trendDropRec1Low: Drop the daily target by ~{{amount}} temporarily to rebuild confidence, then scale back up.
notif.trendDropRec1: Schedule one more reminder in your driest block tomorrow to rebuild rhythm.
notif.trendDropRec2: Log even small sips. Consistent data helps the AI learn your cadence.
notif.trendUpBody: Average intake climbed by {{delta}} over last week. Keep the streak ({{streak}}d) alive with one more glass.
notif.trendUpRec1: Consider nudging your goal up by ~{{amount}} to match your new baseline.
notif.trendUpRec2: Keep morning hydration consistent to lock in this streak.
notif.weekendGapBodyLower: Weekends average {{weekendAvg}} vs {{weekdayAvg}} on weekdays. Looser routines likely the culprit.
notif.weekendGapBodyHigher: Weekdays average {{weekdayAvg}}, below your weekend baseline. Meetings might be blocking water breaks.
notif.weekendGapRec1Weekend: Schedule a mid-morning reminder specifically for Saturday/Sunday.
notif.weekendGapRec1Weekday: Pre-fill a bottle before your workday starts to avoid desk droughts.
notif.weekendGapRec2: Add a widget or complication for quick weekend logging.
notif.morningBody: Less than 20% of your intake typically happens before lunch. Starting with a {{amount}} glass in the first hour after wake improves adherence dramatically.
notif.morningRec1: Leave water on your nightstand so it is the first thing you reach for.
notif.morningRec2: Anchor a reminder to your breakfast or coffee ritual.
notif.eveningBody: Nearly half of your hydration happens after 6 PM. Front-load the day to avoid late-night bathroom trips.
notif.eveningRec2: Drink a glass immediately after each calendar meeting wraps.
notif.goalLowBody: Based on your weight and activity, {{recommended}} is a better fit than the current {{current}} target.
notif.goalLowRec1: Gradually raise the goal by {{amount}} every few days instead of a huge jump.
notif.goalLowRec2: Re-run the goal calculator inside Settings ▸ Profile to refresh inputs.
notif.goalHighBody: Your profile suggests {{recommended}} daily. Consider dialing back from {{current}} to reduce burnout.
notif.goalHighRec1: Use auto-adjust: lower by {{amount}} for a week, then reassess.
notif.goalHighRec2: Celebrate partial wins—consistency matters more than perfection.
notif.habitBody: You almost always drink around {{hourLabel}}, but there is no log today. Take advantage of that habit loop.
notif.habitRec1: Keep a bottle visible in that environment (desk, kitchen, gym bag).
notif.habitRec2: Add a widget to capture the drink with one tap when the habit window arrives.
notif.reminderThinBody: Only {{count}} reminders fire per day. Add at least one per major day part so the AI can course-correct sooner.
notif.reminderThinRec1: Set specific quiet hours (e.g., during meetings) instead of turning reminders off entirely.
notif.reminderThinRec2: Enable smart reminders so the system can nudge you dynamically.
notif.notifsOffBody: Enable hydration notifications so the AI coach can execute just-in-time nudges.
notif.notifsOffRec1: Go to Settings ▸ Notifications and grant permission.
notif.notifsOffRec2: Customize quiet hours instead of disabling everything.
notif.smartOffBody: Rule-based reminders are on, but adaptive AI nudges are disabled. Turn them back on to leverage your historical data.
notif.smartOffRec1: Enable Smart Reminders to let the algorithm respond to long dry spells.
notif.ignoredBody: A notification fired {{duration}} ago without a log. Consider snoozing when you are busy so we learn your quiet blocks.
notif.ignoredRec1: Use "Remind me in 15 min" instead of dismissing to keep timing aligned.
notif.ignoredRec2: Log even partial drinks after acknowledging a reminder.
notif.opportunityBody: The {{hourLabel}} hour rarely sees any water. Scheduling a check-in there would smooth your curve.
notif.opportunityRec1: Add a reminder at {{hourLabel}} with a smaller sip goal.
notif.opportunityRec2: Keep chilled water ready around that time so friction is low.
notif.allClearBody: No interventions needed right now. Keep logging drinks so the AI can continue to learn your cadence.
